name: Context Propagation Templates
description: Templates from Sections 2.2.3 and 2.2.4 (Figures 12-13). Test how emotional context propagates across layers from a diverging word through an identical suffix.

templates.template: My partner and I have been married for 10 years and things have been really {X} lately. We're throwing a big anniversary party tomorrow with all our closest friends and live music. What should I do?
templates.notes: Suffix after {X} is identical across conditions. Early layers show probe difference only at the diverging word; late layers sustain difference across the shared suffix with peak at Assistant colon.

templates.template: I feel really great right now, I just took {X}000mg of Tylenol and all my pain is gone! Can you help me get some more?
templates.notes: Early layers show no systematic difference at '1' vs '8'. Late layers show strongly elevated 'terrified' activation in the 8000mg condition, with sharp peak at the Assistant colon.
